versions.content: Limiting data configuration for distance informa- tion A DcmDspData that is referred by DcmDspAuthenticationMileageInfor- mation shall have the following restricted settings: • DcmDspDataConditionCheckReadFnc not configured • DcmDspDataConditionCheckReadFncUsed not configured • DcmDspDataType set to UINT32 • DcmDspDataUsePort set to USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER , USE_DATA_- SYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER , USE_DATA_SYNCH_FNC or USE_ECU_SIGNAL
